description: Machine-readable inventory of linting audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or the codebase shows mixed adherence to a soft check.

enrichmentFlags.description: Run the detected linter and use its output to enrich the static configuration findings.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns whether the linter runs at each lifecycle stage.
Owns end-to-end accessibility scanning; the jsx-a11y plugin gap surfaces in both.

checks.title: Exactly one linter installed
checks.expectation: Either ESLint or Biome is installed, not both.
checks.violationSignal: Both eslint and @biomejs/biome are present in package.json dependencies.

checks.title: Modern configuration format
checks.expectation: ESLint uses flat config; Biome uses biome.json or biome.jsonc.
checks.violationSignal: ESLint legacy .eslintrc.* format is in use.

checks.title: Single configuration source
checks.expectation: Exactly one configuration file exists at the repository or workspace root.
checks.violationSignal: Multiple top-level configuration files, or both flat and legacy formats present.

checks.title: TypeScript parser configured
checks.expectation: ESLint registers @typescript-eslint/parser with parserOptions.project or projectService so type-aware rules can run; Biome support is implicit.
checks.violationSignal: ESLint configuration without a TypeScript parser despite tsconfig.json being present.

checks.title: Declarative configuration
checks.expectation: The configuration does not require side-effectful evaluation or environment-dependent rule selection.
checks.violationSignal: Configuration that branches on process.env in non-trivial ways.

checks.title: Base recommended set extended
checks.expectation: The base recommended ruleset is extended.
checks.violationSignal: No base ruleset extended.

checks.title: @typescript-eslint recommended-type-checked or stronger
checks.expectation: At least recommended-type-checked is extended; strict-type-checked is preferred.
checks.violationSignal: No @typescript-eslint configuration, or the plain recommended set only.

checks.title: eslint-plugin-react/recommended
checks.expectation: When React is detected, the React recommended config is extended.
checks.violationSignal: React project without the plugin configured.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is not a React project.

checks.title: eslint-plugin-react-hooks/recommended
checks.expectation: When React is detected, the hooks plugin's recommended rules are enabled.
checks.violationSignal: React project without it.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is not a React project.

checks.title: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y/recommended
checks.expectation: When React is detected, the accessibility plugin's recommended rules are enabled.
checks.violationSignal: React project without it.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is not a React project.

checks.title: eslint-plugin-import configured
checks.expectation: The import plugin is configured with the TypeScript resolver plus rules for unresolved imports, import order, and no-cycle.
checks.violationSignal: The plugin is missing, or installed without the TypeScript resolver.

checks.title: eslint-config-prettier last in extends
checks.expectation: When Prettier is in the project, eslint-config-prettier is the last entry in the extends list.
checks.violationSignal: Prettier installed but the config is not added, or added but not last.

checks.title: Node best-practices plugin
checks.expectation: When the project has Node-only entry points, eslint-plugin-n's recommended rules are enabled.
checks.violationSignal: Node entry points present without the plugin.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is a browser-only frontend.

checks.title: Biome linter enabled
checks.expectation: In a Biome project, linter.enabled is true.
checks.violationSignal: The Biome linter is disabled.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project does not use Biome.

checks.title: Biome recommended and domain rule sets enabled
checks.expectation: In a Biome project, recommended rules and each domain rule set (correctness, suspicious, complexity, performance, security, style, plus a11y for React) are enabled or replaced rule-by-rule.
checks.violationSignal: Recommended rules off, or a domain set off without rule-by-rule replacement.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project does not use Biome.

checks.title: Lint script in package.json
checks.expectation: A lint script exists and invokes the detected linter against the project.
checks.violationSignal: No lint script, or the script invokes a different tool.

checks.title: Continuous integration enforces zero warnings
checks.expectation: The continuous-integration lint step uses --max-warnings=0 for ESLint or --error-on-warnings for Biome.
checks.violationSignal: Lint runs without the zero-warnings flag, or lint failures do not fail the build.

checks.title: Type-aware rules actually enabled
checks.expectation: When @typescript-eslint/parser is configured, the project pointer is set so type-aware rules can run.
checks.violationSignal: The parser is configured but the project pointer is missing, so type-aware rules silently no-op.

checks.title: No globally disabled rules without justification
checks.expectation: The configuration does not turn off rules from extended recommended sets globally without an inline comment explaining why.
checks.violationSignal: A rule overridden to off at the top level without a comment.

checks.title: Lint errors fail the build
checks.expectation: Continuous integration treats lint errors as build failures with no || true and no continue-on-error on the lint step.
checks.violationSignal: Workflow patterns that swallow lint failures.

checks.title: Editor integration available
checks.expectation: A workspace-level recommendation exists for the linter's editor extension.
checks.violationSignal: No editor-recommendation configuration.

checks.title: No blanket file-level disables without justification
checks.expectation: A blanket file-level disable carries a free-text justification on the same or preceding line.
checks.violationSignal: A blanket disable with no following justification.

checks.title: Each disable specifies rules
checks.expectation: Inline and next-line disable comments specify which rules they disable, never blanket.
checks.violationSignal: A bare disable comment with no rule names.

checks.title: Each suppression carries a justification
checks.expectation: Every suppression comment is followed by free-text justification.
checks.violationSignal: Suppression comments with no surrounding explanation.

checks.title: Ignore patterns do not exclude production source
checks.expectation: The ignore patterns do not exclude entire production source directories, feature folders, or *.ts/*.tsx blanketly.
checks.violationSignal: Patterns that ignore production code under src/ or the framework equivalent.

checks.title: No stale ignore entries
checks.expectation: Every entry in the ignore list resolves to at least one existing file or directory.
checks.violationSignal: Entries pointing at paths that no longer exist.

checks.title: Suppression density is reasonable
checks.expectation: Files contain at most the threshold number of suppressions each.
checks.violationSignal: Files exceeding the threshold.
